Next year's iPhone Pro model is expected to adopt a brand-new all-glass design to commemorate the 20th anniversary of the iPhone. Yesterday, a new leak detailed the progress of Apple's innovative model.

Here is the latest news about Apple's unique iPhone 20 Pro design

The innovative iPhone Ultra (Apple's first foldable model) will make its debut in a few weeks, but next year will bring another distinctive new iPhone design.

Reports indicate that Apple is preparing a special all-glass design for next year's iPhone Pro model. The new device is said to feature a larger display with curved screens on all four sides, extending to the edges of the body for a visually bezel-less effect.

Yesterday, Weibo leaker Fixed Focus Digital updated on Apple's progress toward this unique look in a new post.

They noted that Apple adopted the same glass assembly process previously used for the iPhone Air, but made improvements to incorporate more curved materials.

The post also pointed out improvements in two areas:

  • Thermal performance
  • Body thickness

It remains difficult to determine Apple's target specifications in terms of thickness and design materials. However, all signs so far indicate that this new device will draw inspiration from the iPhone Air and Ultra, but will not prioritize thinness like those two models.

According to the latest news, the new device appears to blend the design innovations of the iPhone Air and Ultra, while delivering performance and battery life that meet—or even approach—what Pro users expect.

Pro users do not want to sacrifice performance for a thinner body. But if Apple can release a slightly slimmer model with a unique all-glass look while maintaining a comparable user experience, it would be extremely appealing.

How interested are you in next year's rumored iPhone Pro 20 model? Feel free to share in the comments.
